messages:
amanda_csm: FYI -- Crescendo Retail opened a support ticket asking to onboard a compact reranker (search personalization) into Redwood Private. They need private VPC deployment + HSM key for model encryption. They flagged latency target p95 < 60ms and peak throughput ~200 qps (burst 500). They want a canary rollout and automated rollback on quality regression. Ticket CS-98721 created. @leo_ml can you triage viability? :mag_right;

leo_ml: Thanks @amanda_csm. Quick clarifying Qs: what model family/size are they expecting to serve? Are they open to quantized variants (int8/4) or must it be full fp16? Also need sample eval set + labeling schema to estimate nDCG and reranker labels.

amanda_csm: They said they have a trained 7B dense reranker (tensor format) and are open to int8 quantization if we can meet latency. Eval set is ~5k queries with graded relevance (0/1/2). Data stays in their VPC (us-east-1) S3; no PHI. They also asked about audit logs for access (compliance).

maya_solutions: ok noted. For Private + HSM we'll need the customer's KMS ARN and the private control-plane access window. Also propose a two-phase eval: offline nDCG + A/B canary to 5% traffic with real-time quality monitoring. Suggest perf targets: p95 < 60ms on a deduped 512-token sequence after quantization test.

leo_ml: Sounds good. I'll run a quick perf/compat check on a 7B quantized build. Can you drop a small sample of the eval CSV here? Prefer header: query_id,query,doc_id,rank,label. Example:
```
query_id,query,doc_id,rank,label
1,"running shoes red","doc_123",1,2
```

amanda_csm: pasted sample snippet above, customer confirmed labels match that format. Also requested SLA for dedicated pools during canary.

devops-bot: Ticket CS-98721 registered. Linked infra request: IR-4512 (private deployment quota + HSM access). ETA: initial infra readiness check in 48h. :white_check_mark;

andre_ops: For 200 qps peak, recommend 3x-4x GPU headroom depending on batching. If they want sub-60ms p95, we'll test with continuous batching disabled and small batch sizes. Need to know acceptable cost-band vs latency tradeoff.

jack_account: I'm on renewal for Crescendo next month. If onboarding slips past renewal we'll have an increased churn risk — they treat this feature as a deal driver. Let's try to prioritize the canary before renewal date (2025-05-12).

leo_ml: Understood. Plan: 1) compatibility perf run (quantization experiment) in 48h, 2) offline nDCG eval on their 5k set, 3) infra + HSM prep (IR-4512) then 5% canary with monitoring. If perf tests pass, we can aim for canary by 2025-05-08. I'll post results here.

amanda_csm: Great — I'll sync with the customer to confirm KMS details and send them the onboarding checklist + estimated timeline. Logging acceptance criteria for canary: nDCG delta <= 1.5% vs baseline and no safety blacklist hits.

maya_solutions: I'll draft the monitoring playbook (alerts for nDCG regression, latency breaches, error spikes) and share runbooks for rollback.

leo_ml: Quick note — if int4 quant works we can shave 20-30% latency but need to validate quality. Will include int8/int4 comparison in the perf run.

amanda_csm: Thanks team. I'll update CS-98721 with this plan and tag the customer. :thumbsup:
